name: state_loading_store
meaning: state = LOADING before first slot0 copy

meaning: order LOADING before slot0 payload work

name: state_not_loading_branch
meaning: state not LOADING rejects, including ARMED

name: valid_pointer
meaning: r6 = selected slot valid byte, slot_base + 0x9c

name: valid_clear_store
meaning: clear valid before copying selected slot

name: copy_csync
meaning: order payload copy before valid publication

meaning: reload loaded_count after stock memcpy/csync/valid publication because memcpy at 0x02048cce clobbers volatile r3

name: not_last_branch
meaning: only slot15 falls through to ARMED publication

name: armed_csync
meaning: order valid15 and count16 before ARMED

name: reset_push_saved
meaning: preserve caller frame before reset signature inspection

name: reset_sig0_load

name: reset_sig0_mismatch

name: reset_sig1_load
meaning: load BUZZ BASS reset signature byte 1

name: reset_lock_store
meaning: first exact packet clears stale boot lock

name: reset_state_store
meaning: first exact packet sets state = EMPTY

name: reset_csync
meaning: publish reset before invoking sequential producer

name: reset_call_producer
meaning: invoke original sequential producer after optional reset
